verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly position Temporal for durable agent loops that call LLMs and tools and resume exactly where they left off after a failure. The OpenAI Agents SDK integration runs model calls as Activities that retry durably, are not repeated on replay, and survive Worker restarts. Activities are automatically retried, and a cookbook covers durable Claude tool-calling loops. Community users corroborate the general retry and durable-execution model, though not specifically for agent workloads. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of LLM agent loops running on Temporal.
